images.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / environment repaint.
Edit the supplied full game concept painting into ONE complete background-only city panorama, widescreen 16:9.
Remove the foreground cutaway house, both people, furniture, floor tiles, garden furniture and near foreground pond. Continue the futuristic city scenery naturally across the area where the house was.
Preserve the reference's appealing stylized 3D game-art look: clean rounded ceramic forms, rich softly modeled green trees, readable crafted stone cliffs, gentle material highlights and lively sunny color. Keep it clearly a designed game world, with the same visual language as the reference.

High clarity suitable for reviewing the complete environment. No people, playable building interior, game grid, UI, text or watermark.
